Asymmetric Bento grid hierarchy with explicit cell spans (col-span-8, col-span-4, col-span-12).
Every interactive element MUST have hover/active states with high contrast text explicitly set.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, nav links, form inputs, tab buttons, modal triggers, sliders, quote submit buttons) MUST include precise data-testid attributes in kebab-case format.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. In frontend design, avoid AI slop: build sharp, high-precision frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently with crisp 1px borders. DO NOT use muddy dark gradients.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky header and modal dialogs.
Expose grid borders using Tailwind border-white/10 to convey blueprints and infrastructure schemas.
Do NOT center align the main app container. Maintain strict technical left alignment.
Ensure high contrast on hover states. Never rely on default font color inheritance.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
Always test forms with interactive state changes, step indicator progress, toast feedback via Sonner.
